__comment: Room types (doc 34 'Room types'; the room window in doc 23), read by RoomManager and worked out by its RoomKinds component. A sealed room takes the first type whose needs it meets, in this order; with none it is a plain room. A personal bedroom comes before a bedroom, which takes no owner; the bed counts keep barracks apart; rooms with beds come before the dining room, and the pantry and the freezer come last.

needs: what the room must hold. A count has a least and, for beds, a most: beds (whole beds inside), lights (light sources), doors (door pieces), tables (dining tables), seats (stools and benches), fires (hearths and campfires, lit or cold; a torch is a light only) and food_stores (storage furniture that takes food). temperature is a range in °C: above, below, at_most or at_least, each a number or the name of a value in data/world_gen/temperature.json. owner: the room's one bed has an owner.

shows: the room window's heading for the needs ('What makes it a bedroom'). noun: the type inside a sentence ('a bedroom'), as in 'One step from a bedroom'. key: the piece that tells what a plain room is on its way to. A plain room holding it is measured against this type (the one it is fewest needs away from, the first such in this order); a plain room holding no type's key is shown what it could be instead.

climate: how the room window reads the room's warmth: comfort (heating, and the temperature dwarves sleep well in) or keeping (how long food keeps). symbol: its picture, one of dock.json's room_symbols. gives: what the type is for, on the window's Types tab. variant_of: a type the Types tab lists under another.

things: each need's words and picture. label names its row; a is how a missing one reads in a step ('add a bed'), full how the Types tab names it, many its plural, unit what its count is counted in ('1 source'), step a whole step of its own, symbol its picture when that is not its own id.

kinds.label: Bedroom
kinds.gives: Give the bed an owner: they sleep happier in a bedroom of their own, and the others keep out.

kinds.label: Barracks
kinds.gives: Beds for many. Dwarves keep their own beds here, without an owner's bonus.

kinds.label: Dining room
kinds.shows: What makes it a dining room
kinds.gives: Dwarves eat best at a table and seat, and feel the room's appeal after the meal.

kinds.label: Pantry
kinds.gives: Food keeps longer in the cool. Rock overhead keeps summer out; higher rooms are colder.

kinds.label: Freezer
kinds.gives: Frozen food barely spoils. Rooms freeze high on the mountain, in the depth of winter.
